ops.title: hermes tart→Apple-container migration COMPLETE (Architecture B)
ops.body:
**Done 2026-07-18/19.** hermes migrated from a tart NixOS VM to an Apple `container` OCI container named `hermes` on the macOS host (Architecture B). Agent runs unprivileged (uid 1000 + supplementary **group 0** — load-bearing for the virtiofs-idmapped proxy socket, cc-note ca8ac58f). Supervised by `com.yclaw.container-hermes` (resident KeepAlive tick, re-execs every 60s, recreates the container if absent — the lifecycle fix, since apple/container has no boot-autostart/restart verb). Egress firewall via `com.yclaw.container-pf-refresh`.

**Landed as a 5-commit local stack on top of cf6a148c** (WIP, path-scoped to exclude a concurrent session's vault-image work):
1. `feat(yclaw)` container-exec transport + container health probes
2. `feat(yclaw)` hermes CLI repoint (machines.json flip + doctor/status/onboard/ssh/logs/restart/wait)
3. `refactor(scripts)` retire the tart-hermes runner + deploy flow
4. `refactor(hermes.nix)` strip dead tart-only config (guest-eval-verified ZERO settings drift)
5. `fix(migration)` complete the repoint in destroy.sh/bootstrap.sh + gates.py MANUAL message

**Verification:** 355 pytest pass, ruff+ty clean; guest `nix eval` of `nixosConfigurations.hermes...services.hermes-agent.settings` byte-identical base-vs-stripped + container-image drv still evaluates; live `yclaw doctor hermes` green (node up, agent alive uid1000+group0, →metal ok). Only FAIL = the `last-ok` marker until the doctor-marker tick is reinstalled.

**Decommission (user: "delete everything now"):** hermes-old tailnet node deleted (also removed the stale 100.95.192.38 that caused a webhook-bind blip), tart hermes VM gone, e3-probe/e3-probe-int prototype containers deleted. Deleting the e3 containers glitched the shared vmnet NAT → full model-plane outage → recovered via `container system restart` (see [[apple-container-vmnet-nat-breaks-on-container-deletes]]).

**Config source:** `nixos/hermes.nix` `services.hermes-agent.settings` still feeds the image (flake `hermes-container-image` → `nixosConfigurations.hermes`); the entrypoint renders config.yaml + env. Model plane unchanged (metal:8000/8317/8765, egress via HTTPS_PROXY@metal:14322). State bind-mounted: `~/.yclaw/state/hermes`→`/var/lib/hermes`, `hermes-ts-state`→`/var/lib/tailscale`.

**OPEN follow-ups:** (1) container does NOT trust the agent-vault MITM CA (only pkgs.cacert), so external egress via metal:14322 is unwired — task #38, needs image/entrypoint change + rebuild. (2) doctor `last-ok` marker: reinstall the fixed tick (`/tmp/container-hermes.fixed.sh` → `/usr/local/lib/yclaw/container-hermes.sh`, sudo; supervisor re-execs in 60s). (3) docs (CHANGELOG/ARCHITECTURE/DEPLOY) + push the stack + CI watch. (4) from-scratch container bring-up is a gated MANUAL step (image load + `setup.sh host-container` + supervisor), not automated in bootstrap.
